component.name: Dendro
component.summary: Visual package manager and dependency hierarchy explorer

description.p: Dendro is a fast graphical package manager for Fedora Linux.

ul.li: Fast, asynchronous querying of the system RPM database
Multi-level visual dependency and sub-dependency tree exploration
Safe privileged installation and removal via Polkit

screenshot.caption: Main tree view exploring package dependencies and queued operations

description.p: Initial release featuring lazy-loaded dependency trees and Pamac-style queue management.
